channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Russian missile attack kills three in Ukraine’s Kyiv
item.description: Residents trapped as partially collapsed building catches fire after deadly strike on Ukrainian capital.

item.title: Israel launches attacks across Gaza one day after Hamas agrees to disarm
item.description: Israeli attacks across Gaza have killed at least two Palestinians, hours after Hamas agreed to a draft peace deal.

item.title: Iran war live: Trump threatens strikes, Iran says it has a plan to respond
item.description: An Iranian official quoted by Tasnim says comprehensive plans are in place to respond to any 'mad' US strikes.

item.title: Analyst: the US faces a strategic ‘dead end’ in Iran
item.description: Washington has reached a strategic impasse with Iran, says a former analyst for the US Congress.

item.title: At least 25 people killed, dozens injured in Algeria bus crash
item.description: At least 25 people have been killed and dozens others injured in a bus crash in Algeria.

item.title: Poland protests to Russian ambassador over missile incursion
item.description: Warsaw asserts missile recently made, illustrating Russia's nightly barrage against Ukraine is draining arsenal.

item.title: Bowen: Plan for Hamas to disarm faces big obstacles, yet it offers rare hope for Gaza
item.description: The realities of politics, war, zero trust, the deaths of thousands and the destruction of Gaza will make any agreement very complicated.

item.title: At least five members of same family killed in Russian missile attack, Zelensky says
item.description: A six-year-old girl and two boys, aged 11 and 17, were among six killed in a village near the central city of Kryvyi Rih.

item.title: Why limited war with the US may suit Iran better than peace
item.description: Iran may believe it can control its conflict carefully enough to keep pressure on the US while avoiding an all-out war.

item.title: Danube's record low levels force shutdown of Hungary's only nuclear plant
item.description: Romania, Bulgaria and Serbia are also grappling with the effects of a series of prolonged heatwaves and low rainfall.
